svg.aria-label: Lumen screen probes: filtered hit distance
svg.title: Lumen screen probes: filtered hit distance
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. Lumen screen probes: filtered hit distance graph 0001 | 640x672 R8 UNORM | sqrt-encoded, MaxHalfFloat=65504 hit distance (log10, near=blue -> far=red) no hit: encoded at MaxHalfFloat (65504) invalid ray (decoded < 0) Source: LumenScreenProbeTracingCommon.ush:48-57 encodes sqrt(HitDistance/65504)*254/255 + 1/255 into R8 UNORM and decodes with (enc^2*65504 - 1/255)*255/254. The decode is applied exactly. GetProbeMaxHitDistance() is MaxHalfFloat = 65504 (LumenScreenProbeCommon.ush:234-237); the encoded maximum is a no-hit/miss, drawn blue and excluded from the hit-distance distribution. The R8 stores 8 bits of precision; the figure is a display of the decoded distance, not a claim of full float precision.
